beats.label: S1 · A lease with the cartel
beats.text: Landman Tommy Norris leases an oilfield from a Mexican cartel for M-Tex; a stolen company plane and drug drop end in a fatal crash he covers up with the sheriff.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the cartel entanglement that drives every other conflict in the series.

beats.label: S1 · The wellhead blast
beats.text: His son Cooper's first day in the field ends when a wellhead explosion kills his entire crew, saddling M-Tex with widow settlements and mounting liability.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The blast is the wound the whole season pays for legally, financially, and personally.

beats.label: S1 · Falcone and Ariana
beats.text: M-Tex brings in causation lawyer Rebecca Falcone to contain the fallout; Cooper joins veteran roughneck Boss's crew and grows close to a dead crewman's widow, Ariana.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Rebecca and Ariana, both of whom become central to seasons after.

beats.label: S1 · Angela comes back
beats.text: Tommy's ex-wife Angela returns during their daughter's stay, seduces him, then divorces her current husband as the two quietly rekindle their relationship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the family unit that anchors Tommy's home life going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Guardsmen over the fields
beats.text: As the cartel shakes Tommy down for the lost drug shipment, Monty pulls in the governor; National Guard helicopters 'training' over the fields kill a cartel transfer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The escalation that turns cartel pressure from harassment into open war.

beats.label: S1 · Cooper goes wildcat, Monty falters
beats.text: Cooper quits M-Tex to buy up small oil leases across West Texas; Monty suffers a heart attack, makes Tommy VP, then names him successor in his will.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up both Cooper's independent play and Tommy's path to the top of M-Tex.

beats.label: S1 · Gallino saves Tommy, Monty dies
beats.text: The cartel kidnaps Tommy to torture him; cartel head Gallino himself arrives, kills his lieutenant, and spares Tommy — the same night Monty dies on the operating table.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the personal debt to Gallino and the power vacuum at M-Tex that season 2 opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Monty is dead, Tommy is about to become president of M-Tex, and he owes Gallino his life. Cooper has quietly bought up leases whose value no one yet knows, and Monty's widow Cami is the wildcard who now owns everything.
questions: Will Tommy actually take the presidency of M-Tex, and on whose terms?
How will Gallino cash in the debt Tommy now owes him?
What kind of owner will Monty's widow Cami turn out to be?

characters.name: Tommy Norris
characters.line: M-Tex's landman, just promoted to VP and named Monty's successor; owes Gallino his life after being kidnapped and spared.

characters.name: Cooper Norris
characters.line: Tommy's son, quit M-Tex after surviving the wellhead blast that killed his crew; now living with widow Ariana and buying his own oil leases.

characters.name: Angela Norris
characters.line: Tommy's ex-wife, back in Midland after leaving her second husband and rekindling things with Tommy.

characters.name: Ainsley Norris
characters.line: Tommy and Angela's teenage daughter, boy-crazy and orbiting between her parents' households.

characters.name: Monty Miller
characters.line: The M-Tex owner who built the company; died on the operating table after his second heart attack.

characters.name: Cami Miller
characters.line: Monty's widow, poised to inherit ownership of M-Tex while Tommy takes the presidency per the will.

characters.name: Rebecca Falcone
characters.line: M-Tex's aggressive causation lawyer, brought in to minimise settlements after the wellhead deaths.

characters.name: Ariana Medina
characters.line: Widow of a roughneck killed in the wellhead blast; Cooper moved into her home after being beaten by her in-laws.

characters.name: Danny 'Gallino' Morrell
characters.line: Head of the Mexican cartel on M-Tex's lease; personally arrived to save Tommy from his own men, creating a debt Tommy now owes.

beats.label: S2 · Cami takes over, Cooper strikes
beats.text: Cami Miller assumes control of M-Tex and vows she'll be more ruthless than Monty; Cooper's six new wells all strike oil but were funded by a Gallino front company.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the season's twin pressures: Cami's leadership and Cooper's unknowing entanglement with the cartel.

beats.label: S2 · Burying Mom, T.L. moves in
beats.text: Tommy's mother dies; the family drives to Canadian to bury her, and Angela invites his estranged father T.L. to live out his days in Midland with them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reintroduces T.L. as a permanent household figure and reframes Tommy's family life.

beats.label: S2 · The $420M lawsuit
beats.text: An insurer sues M-Tex over a $420M hurricane settlement, forcing Cami to gamble on drilling a new Gulf of Mexico gas well in 45 days to satisfy the contract.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This suit is the pressure that drives every one of Cami's later, riskier decisions.

beats.label: S2 · Cami borrows from Gallino
beats.text: Not knowing he runs a cartel, Cami approaches Gallino herself for the loan to fund the offshore rig, securing it with M-Tex's royalties.
beats.whyLoadBearing: M-Tex is now leveraged to Gallino at the ownership level, not just through Tommy.

beats.label: S2 · Cooper bought back into M-Tex
beats.text: Tommy buys Cooper out of the cartel-funded lease deal and brings him back to M-Tex, but Gallino gloats he now has Cami on the hook regardless.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Tommy realises he cannot extract his family from Gallino because Gallino is already inside M-Tex.

beats.label: S2 · Tommy fired, Cooper accused
beats.text: Cami fires Tommy for pushing safer litigation instead of the long-odds gas well; back in Midland, Cooper beats Ariana's attacker so badly the man dies in the ER.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The double blow that ends Tommy's tenure at M-Tex and nearly ends Cooper's freedom.

beats.label: S2 · CTT Oil, and a threat
beats.text: Charges against Cooper are dropped; Tommy forms Gallino-funded CTT Oil, poaching M-Tex's loyal core — Gallino warns if this venture fails he'll take what Tommy loves most.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season ends with Tommy running a rival cartel-backed outfit under a personal threat that hangs over everything ahead.

cliffhanger.text: Tommy has taken his loyalists and his son out of M-Tex to run a rival oil outfit funded entirely by cartel money. Cami is left holding a debt-drowning M-Tex and a Gulf rig on a coin-flip, and Gallino has warned Tommy that if CTT fails he will take what Tommy loves most.
questions: Will CTT's new wells produce fast enough to keep Gallino satisfied?
What is Cami's move if the offshore gas well comes up dry and the loan comes due?
Who will Gallino go after if he decides to take what Tommy loves most?

characters.name: Tommy Norris
characters.line: Fired from M-Tex, now running rival CTT Oil on Gallino's money; remarried Angela and pulled his father, son, and closest lieutenants into the new venture.

characters.name: Cami Miller
characters.line: M-Tex's owner, in over her head financially, having secured the company's survival with a loan from a man she doesn't know runs a cartel.

characters.name: Cooper Norris
characters.line: Back at M-Tex briefly, then flipped to CTT as its president; engaged to Ariana after nearly beating her attacker to death.

characters.name: Ariana Medina
characters.line: Cooper's fiancée, attacked at her bartending job and now working inside Tommy's new company.

characters.name: Angela Norris
characters.line: Remarried Tommy and settling the extended family — including his estranged father — into the Midland house.

characters.name: T.L. Norris
characters.line: Tommy's estranged, once-abusive father; a widower now living out his days with Tommy's family in Midland.

characters.name: Rebecca Falcone
characters.line: Former M-Tex in-house counsel, now COO and chief counsel of CTT; involved with Gulf rig geologist Charlie.

characters.name: Danny 'Gallino' Morrell
characters.line: Cartel head now bankrolling both sides — Cami's Gulf gamble at M-Tex and Tommy's new CTT — and personally threatening Tommy if his venture fails.
